text: Blackland Ironhoof was a centaur who ran the Agri Plantation in Thay circa 1362 DR and was the father of Wynter.
Bloodbag imps were a specialized variety of imp that served the Nine Hells as an informal nurse corps.
Blog was a troll guard in the dwarven prison in Undermountain controlled by Horazak in the mid–14 century DR.
Blancheflor was one of the Squires of the Order of Tye, an elite organization dedicated to guarding the members of the Lords' Alliance circa 1372 DR.
Blaz Merrymar was a strongheart halfling merchant in the village of Shining Falls in the Delimbiyr Vale in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Blaervaer Lorndessar, who was also called the Reluctant, was the fifth King of the Eorn/Lorndessar Dynasty who ruled the city-state of Westgate.
Blackfingers Ralingor was an infamous pirate captain of the Kissing Shark in the Utter East circa 1371 DR.
Battlemaster Bladreth Crackbone was the High Priest of Tempus in Battlehall in the Foreign Quarter of Zhentil Keep in the .
Bleskos Wavesilver was a lord and noble of the Waterdhavian noble house Wavesilver during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Blackrabbas Khuulthund was a Tethyrian sage inhabiting Waterdeep during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Lord Blester was a member of the court of Cormyr in the mid-14 century DR.
Blanchard Pike was one of the outlaw mercenary band from Cormyr called the Iron Collar Band, active in the early 14 century DR.
Blackwood was a human officer of the Neverwinter Guard in Neverwinter in the late 15 century DR.

The Blatant Beast was a strange monster that roamed throughout the Kingdom of Mertwig in search of stories and rhymes. Anyone that managed to tell the creature a tale that was to its liking would be gifted treasure, whilst though whose stories failed to impress would be attacked.
Blepp was a kobold from the Dragon's Rest cloister in the late 15 century DR.
Blanc was a Netherese thief who worked as a guide in Karsus Enclave until its destruction in . She was one of those locals who gave guided tours to visitors.
Blaise Hhune was a member of the Hhune patriar family of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Blaedron was a person known to a War Wizard of Cormyr in the late 14 century DR.

Blikwik the Beast was a creature of unknown type from the Land of the Beastly Brigands in the Whamite Isles. Together with Badmuddin the Bald, Blikwik represented the Land of the Beastly Brigands in a series of wild conflicts between various nations and pirates of the Whamite Isles at some point prior to the mass death of the population in the .
Blaskar Toldovar was an old slaver operating out of Scornubel until the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Blaeragh Ridranus was a slyblade assassin for the Zhentarim in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Blackfeather was the alias used by a Harper agent who was active in the cities of Eshpurta of Amn, and Darromar of Tethyr in the late 15 century DR.
Bloodmoon Claw was a deadly velociraptor made to be a gladiator and one of the pain-bringers of the Slaughterhouse Arena of Tyraturos, Thay, at the very end of the 15 century DR.

Bledryn Scoril was a member of the Scoril noble house of Cormyr, as well as the Crown's representative to, and Lord of, Marsember, having taken over the role from Ildool. He was the local Herald, Grand Marsember, and acted as the registrar of births, deaths, and marriages, as well as the Crown's witness to sentencing, contracts, treaties, and the like.

Boldovar "the Mad" was the 16th Obarskyr monarch and the king of Cormyr until his apparent death in 242 DR. Although Boldovar was the second eldest male child, he was crowned after his father, Tharyann, and outlived his older siblings.
Boo was the pet and companion of the Rashemi ranger Minsc, having joined him shortly after he sustained an injury to his head.
The book of Dellanil Quil'quien was an ancient tome containing the writings of Dellanil Quil'quien, an elf king of Shilmista and one of the forest's legendary heroes.
Booter was the dungeon master and the "official torturer" of the Shadow Thieves in Amn in the late 14 century DR.
Bolhur "Thunderaxe" the Clanless was a dwarf who was the father of Durlag Trollkiller.
Boareskyr was the adventurer who founded the bridge known as Boareskyr Bridge during the early days of human settlement.
The Book of Tarchamus was a sentient artifact book that actually held the consciousness of the ancient Netherese arcanist Tarchamus the Unyielding.
Bogo Rath was an evil wizard who was affiliated with the Night Masks and Castle Trinity in the mid–14 century DR.
Bol was a tiefling warrior and a member of the Bounty Hunters of Cavus Dun in the mid–15 century DR.
Bollus, nicknamed Copperteeth, was an owner of a caravan company based in Westgate on the Dragon Coast and a member of the Rundeen in the late 14 century DR.
Bogclaw was a lizardfolk in Twilight Marsh near Phlan in 1489 DR.
The Blue Lady was a spellplague-changed sirine worshiped by the Choir cult.
Bolton Brimwell was an innkeeper of the Guts and Garters in the Lower Heart of Skullport.
Bokika Hokio was a disgraced daimyo in Wa around 1357 DR and 1358 DR.
Boldor Steelshield was a member of the Council of Elders of Everlund sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.

Blue slaadi, also known as talon slaads, were members of the slaad race and rivals to the interrelated red slaadi. The batrachian bullies were generally superior to them in every way, but only barely so, and were still considered to be of low status.
Bokuri Nesra was a master potter in the city of Tu Pe in Koryo around 1357 DR. Bokuri Nesra owned a business and yard in the north of the city, near the Renuki Do Jang.
Bludwite Sharp-pick was a wealthy dwarven nobleman of Almorel in the Hordelands in 1357 DR.
Bondari, also known as Bondari Quickhand or Bondari Halfman, was a novice adventurer and thief.
Boofie McLaddin was a guard in Luskan in the mid–15 century DR.
Bluster was a brown bear who was a friend of the ranger Montolio "Mooshie" Debrouchee in the early 14 century DR.
A bog bloke was a short tree-like creature with twisted limbs. They were sometimes referred to as "self-delivering kindling" by those of Nesmé.
Boorvald Orcbane was great chief of the Uthgardt Tree Ghost tribe around the time of the War of the Silver Marches of 1485 DR.
Bock was the Guildmaster of the Purple Masks Guild , a thieves' guild located in Iriaebor in the mid–14 century DR.
Bogohardt Blackmane was a shaman of the Black Lion tribe in the mid to late–14 century DR.

A bonegouge assassin was a type of demon found within the Abyss. Bonegouge assassins were rumored to originally be creations of Orcus, and were wholly devoted to whatever task they were bid to complete. Bonegouge assassins were unique in their loyalty and the skill and determination with which they completed their tasks, which set them apart from others of their kind.
Bonegnasher was the ogre leader of a group of bandits and slavers who occupied the Tomb of Damara in the forests outside of the villages of Shadowdale and Freedale in the mid–14 century DR.
Bolifaena, also known as Bolfae, was a yochlol hadndmaiden of Lolth in the early 14 century DR.
Boonmoppet was a lonely imp merchant who resided in his long-dead master's tower in the Western Farmlands outside of Daggerford'd walls circa 1372 DR.
Bodvar, better known as Bodvar the Black, was a chieftain of the Moor Eagle clan of Vaasa in the mid-to-late 13 century DR. He was the first ruler of the Granite Tower.
Bohaim was a young mage from Suzail that served as a member of the Company of Dawn during the mid–14 century DR.
Bo Moss was the youngest child of the Moss family of the Twilight Marsh. Baby Bo was born sometime during the late 15 century DR.
Bohle was a skilled thief inhabiting the city of Daggerford in the Western Heartlands in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Blue Bess was a female miniature behir used for breeding at the Behir's Nest shop in Khaerbaal circa 1370 DR.
Bokasin was the precept of the settlement of Rauthgor in northern Mulhorand during the mid–14 century DR.
King Bonrial was a ruler of Estagund in the Shining South during the 10 century DR.
Blynn, who was nicknamed Blynn the Wild, was a wealthy merchant inhabiting the Shining South during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Bolan was an alchemist and priest of Shar in Yhaunn who presided over the hidden temple of Shar there up until 1373 DR.
Battlelord Boneblaster was the priest of Gloryhall, the shrine of Tempus in Halfhap in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.

Boldric Blacknee was a shiftless young halfling who helped run the Blacknee's Halfhappenstance inn circa 1369 DR with his parents Buzzrip Blacknee and Broonella Blacknee, and his elder siblings Breena Blacknee and Billyup Blacknee.
Capt'n Bob Holmes was a human pirate from the isle of Brynnlaw in the Sea of Swords who sailed the Bleedin' Mary vessel in the late 14 century DR.
"Honest Jack" Bomhoff was a reputable merchant in Sigil that dealt in exotic novelties.
Bloris Meadhoney was an employee of the Counting House and columnist for Baldur's Mouth in the late 15 century DR.
Bonecruncher was a young and ill-tempered allosaurus who competed in the dinosaur races of Port Nyanzaru in Chult during the late 15 century DR.
Blossom Brislen was a daughter of Leepak and Dharin Brislen and sister to Bunny, all inhabitants of the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Admiral Bluenose was an infamous Dread Pirate servant of Umberlee, the Bitch Queen, who lived sometime before the late 14 century DR.
Bombasto was a barbarian patron of the Elfsong Tavern from the city of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Bonegnasher the Cursed was an orc who found his end as a prisoner gladiator in Wheloon Prison in the late 15 century DR.
Bohemund the Belligerent was a wizard and a street entertainer from the city of Westgate in the late 14 century DR.

Blunce Tetoco was one of the children of Oliver Tefoco, the proprietor of the Beehive Goods and Wares general store in the Lower City of Baldur's Gate, who joined the Flaming Fists in the late 15 century DR.
Bolok was a domesticated bear, formerly belonging to a group of gypsies, that lived in the Kingdom of Mertwig around the 14 century DR.
Bobbish Brankstone was a man who lived along the High Road of Cormyr between Tyrluk and Eveningstar in the late 15 century DR.
Bogfang Ravager was a grung gladiator and one of the pain-bringers of the Slaughterhouse Arena of Tyraturos at the very end of the 15 century DR.
Blue Pete was a gladiator and one of the pain-bringers of the Slaughterhouse Arena of Tyraturos at the very end of the 15 century DR.
Bolthrax Brightscale was a dragonborn paladin of Bahamut in the late 15 century DR. He was one of many adventurers that traveled together as the Battlemarked Heroes.

Blug was a black bear of Cormyr in the mid–14 century DR, who may have been swept up in battles with the Night Parade when they attacked Arabel. It was no exaggeration to say that Blug was an exceptional bear in many ways.

Boar-Breath was a hobgoblin in the Lostafinga tribe, who served under Lieutenant Julla, in the mid-to-late 14 century DR. Boar-Breath wasn't his true name, but rather a nickname he had received as a veteran of the troop from sergeants Cheff and Smut, derived from him having terrible breath.

Bokkum was a dwarf and a travelling companion of Tred McKnuckles. He had a brother named Stokkum. He was killed in 1370 DR when a band of orcs and frost giants attacked the caravan in which he was travelling.
Blundebel Eldroon was a member of the minor noble house of Eldroon in Marsember.

Branwen was a cleric of Tempus who lived in the mid–14 century DR. Although she was from an island chain to the southwest, she spent some significant time adventuring the Sword Coast. Despite being a cleric of Tempus, she also frequently invoked Valkur's name.
Brenna Grannox was the wife and consort of Ternan Grannox, Lord-Mayor of Darromar, capital of Tethyr.
Brant Rethalshield was a human priest of Lathander in the late 14 century DR. He was an aspirant to the Order of the Aster and was the squire of Grayth Holmfast.
Borth Jhandelspar was a barbarian who worked as a guide in Triboar in the Savage Frontier.
Brace Skatterhawk was a knight and a member of the Skatterhawk noble family in Cormyr who rode with Princess Alusair Obarskyr.

Brandobaris () was the halfling deity of thievery and an exarch of Sheela Peryroyl in the late 1400s DR. He was the misapprehensions of halflings held by most races in divine form. He was constantly scheming and meddling, as he was curious and with a short attention span. Where the tall races would put more interest in one's purse than his character, Brandobaris cared for character more.
Borador "Goldhand" (a moniker picked up for his legendary avarice) was a dwarf treasure-hunter and rogue active in the mid–14 century DR.
Borem of the Lake of Boiling Mud was a primordial and one of the mysterious Seven Lost Gods.

A brain golem was an eight-foot-tall humanoid-shaped construct made entirely of brain tissue with a bud of an elder brain for a head. These creations existed only to serve an elder brain and its illithid community. They did not communicate in any way and only reacted to the telepathic orders of mind flayers, and could not attack any mind flayer.

Prince Brennus Tanthul was the youngest of the twelve Princes of Shade sired by High Prince Telamont Tanthul, and one that played an important role in the early years of the Second Sundering in the late 15 century DR, and eventually the second collapse of Sakkors.

Bran Skorlsun was a well-respected member of the Harpers of the mid-to-late 14 century DR. He dared to love an elven princess, Amnestria Moonflower, and was the father of Arilyn Moonblade and was also a key driver in the Harper Schism that led to the creation of the Tel'Teukiira. He was known as the Raven (as bran means "raven" in an ancient Moonshae language).
Brace Lenalice, who usually went by Brace the Bold, was a gnome bard who lived in Westgate.
Brack'thal Xorlarrin was a drow wizard of House Xorlarrin in Menzoberranzan in the 14 and 15 century DR.
Bowdar was an inhabitant of the city of Tantras in the Vast. Bowdar owned Bowdar's Wagonworks, which was dedicated to the construction and repair of wagons.
Braerindra Calauth was an elven woman who was the last of House Calauth in Cormanthyr. After her death, she rose as a baelnorn and was entrusted by the Coronal to act as guardian of his quarters.
Brandilar was the guard captain of the Merchant's League headquarters in Baldur's Gate.
Braelin Janquay was a drow scout within Jarlaxle's Bregan D'aerthe.

Lord Brambleberry was a noble of Waterdeep. He held a great hatred for Luskan's pirate activity. In 1376 DR, he agreed with Captain Deudermont of the Sea Sprite to reform Luskan by eliminating the High Captains of Luskan and the Arcane Brotherhood. Lord Brambleberry gathered his family's troops and together with Deudermont invaded Luskan. They were victorious in the fighting against the Brotherhood's forces (the High Captains having retreated to see who was the victor of the battle). In the main attack against the Host Tower of the Arcane, the Archmage Arcane escalated the battle to extremes and forced Deudermont and Brambleberry to destroy the Host Tower. However, the destruction of the tow
Bradda was a sage in Neverwinter in circa 1480 DR; she was very competent about Enchantment and Runestone.
Boruse Temlor was the head cleric of Cyric at the Citadel of the Raven in 1367 DR.
Brace Ulmemur () was a member of the Waterdeep City Watch in the 14 century DR.
Boronuil Ironfist was a dwarven craftsman living in Galdel in 1367 DR.
Braden Yil was a merchant retainer of House Cadorna of Phlan in 1489 DR.
Borri mac Rogni was a dwarf priest of Moradin in the Moonsea.
Breex Vandermast was an evil half-orc sorcerer living in Hillsfar in the late 14 century DR.
Brandyr was one of the fire giant lieutenants of Queen Hledh Hellspawn, who ruled the city of Maerimydra in the Deep Wastes in the late 15 century DR.
Brenna Graycloak was a human wizard and councilor for the village of Glarondar in Aglarond in the mid–14 century DR.
Bremaerel was a sage in Westgate in 1370 DR. He was a member of the Guild of Naturalists and a zoologist specializing in stirges.
Bouladin al-Mutajalli was the Amir of the jann of the House of Sihr within the High Desert of Zakhara in 1367 DR.
Bishop Braccio was one of the members of the Council of Ten in New Phlan in the mid–14 century DR.
Borstag Duncastle was a merchant prince and an official of Ordulin in Sembia in the late 14 century DR.
Bramas Thorntree was a thief and smuggler in Tethyr in 1370 DR.
Boubakar was the spymaster of Golconda in Turmish in 1358 DR.
Brathes was the bodyguard of the new pharaoh of Mulhorand in 1357 DR.
Borsipa was an apprentice member of the Northern Wizards in Unther in 1357 DR.
Bosturo was a noted sage and keeper of the Muradi Lighthouse in Koryo around 1357 DR.
Borigon Hillsafar was the king of Clan Hillsafar in Vaasa in the late 15 century DR.
Bransuldyn Mirrortor was a gnome cleric of Oghma in Berdusk in 1359 DR.
Borenorak was a treasure hunter and cleric of Icewind Dale in the mid–14 century DR. He may have joined the companions in their journey to Menzoberranzan.
Brarindra Harbright was one of the proprietors of the newly opened Roaring Dragon House just outside of Waterdeep circa the Year of Wild Magic, 1372 DR.
Boswell C. Peddywinkle was a well-connected and well-known caravan merchant who routinely traveled the Ten Towns and Luskan trading in scrimshaw in the mid–14 century DR.
Branoch was a shopkeeper of the Bruenghor Clan of the Sunset Mountains.
Brega was the chief inspector for the Athkatlan government circa the mid–14 century DR.
Brennan Risling was an adventurer lived in west Faerûn during the mid–14 century DR.
Captain Brage was the captain of the guard in the town of Nashkel during the mid–14 century DR.
Brawn was a member of the Wraith of the Inner Sea privateer fleet in the mid–14 century DR. Circa 1357 DR, Brawn was the first mate of the Sea Horse.
Brenjer was a merchant that dealt in arms, often sending guarded caravans through the Shadow Gap to Daggerdale circa 1350 DR.
Braakus Sinjen was the apprentice and the right hand to the Guild Master Georges of the Shadow Thieves' guild branch in Undermountain in the mid–14 century DR.
Brandy Quickstep was a halfling resident of Neverwinter during the late 15 century DR.
Private Branley was a soldier of the Neverwinter Guard who fought for his city during the late 15 century DR.
Braxats were a nasty, brutish species that enjoyed tormenting their prey. They were counted as scalykind by other Scaled Ones.
Bortas was a farmer of the town of Ghars in Cormyr in the mid–14 century DR.
Doctor Braum was a medical doctor of the town of Ghars in Cormyr in the mid–14 century DR.
Brakkis Elspaar was a member of the Stone-Cold Reavers, a group of reckless adventurers who made their living sometimes as sellswords and sometimes as brigands.
Braetha Sturnshon was the eldest daughter of Hlargrim Sturnshon, who along with her eight sisters worked at the Dryad's Dreams, the only festhall in Mosstone, Tethyr in the mid-to-late-14 century DR.
Braethan Cazondur was a Lord of Waterdeep in the late 15 century DR.
Brellan Starav was the Commander of the Order of the Golden Cup in Damara as of DR.
Botu'Astok was a local god among the Astok hill tribe of the Furrowed Mountains of north Zakhara.
Brehnan Mueller was a Cormyrean man that lived in a small house west of Calantar's Way during the mid–14 century DR.
Brem was an agent of the Zhentarim that operated out of their hideout along the Risen Road in the late 15 century DR.
Brak Keldurr was the Urphong, or mayor, of Mulsantir in Rashemen during the late 14 century DR.
Brastynbold "Oldhelm" Elphaendim was a member of the noble merchant House Elphaendim of Arrabar in the Vilhon Reach in the late 14 century DR.
Brathtar was a commander of the Empyrean Knights in Stardeep until .
Breltora Red-Eye was a half-orc stonemason in Leilon in the late 15 century DR.
Branon Oakheart was a traveling merchant and a druid of Silvanus who briefly settled in the city of Hillsfar circa 1373 DR.
Boward was an agent of the Harpers that operated out of Neverwinter during the late 15 century DR. She played an important role in coordinating the response against the emergent Cult of the Dragon.
Bordovan was one of the four bartenders who also worked as bouncers of the Copper Coronet in the River District of Athkatla, in the late 14 century DR.
Boroland Nevilard was a wandering bard of the late mid-13 century DR.
Lord Bowharp was an inhabitant of Cormanthor in the 3 century DR.
Bran Oakenshire was one of the Stalwart Lions, masters of Crosswinds Keep as of .
Bralzaer Windriver was the youngest son of Sabrast Windriver in the mid-14 century DR.
Boroldira was the daughter of Borold and Nalitheen in the 14 century DR.
Borgul was a dog belonging to Tamaeril Bladesemmer in the mid-14 century DR.
Brastimeir, also known as Brastimeir the Bold, was a mage who challenged the Simbul prior to . She won, and Brastimeir perished.
Brathan Zilmer was a retired warrior inhabiting Waterdeep, City of Splendors, during the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Boult was a dwarf who was imprisoned for treason in Tethyr during the mid-15 century DR.
Borin Woodbracer was a dwarven ex-adventurer who worked for Lord Partic Thistle as a handyman at Thistleflame Keep circa 1369 DR.
Bord was the son of Storric, the miller in the village of Tweyar in Tethyr in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Borok Thundercracker was a dwarfish hero who lived long before the 14 century DR.
Brenna was a human adventurer and leader of the Puppetmasters company circa 1369 DR.
Brelm was a cobbler from the City of Coin, Athkatla in Amn in the 14 century DR.

Breena Blacknee was a charming young halfling who helped run the Blacknee's Halfhappenstance inn circa 1369 DR with her parents Buzzrip Blacknee and Broonella Blacknee, and her younger siblings Billyup Blacknee and Boldric Blacknee.
Brawn McGable was a human bandit who settled in Phandalin during the late 15 century DR.
Sharp-eye Breg was a goblin scout and member of the Cult of the Absolute who dwelled within the Shattered Sanctum during the late 15 century DR.
Braeryl Barelder was a young Cormyrean noblewoman of the Barelder family in the late 15 century DR.
Brathwen was a duergar slaver and a cultist of the Absolute who dwelled Grymforge during the late 15 century DR.
Brandy Fumblebuckle was an adventurer in Cormyr with the Grand Fist company in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Brasker was a warrior in service to the Cult of the Dragon in the mid-14 century DR.
Stompin' Borzz the Ratcatcher was a pest exterminator from the Lower City of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.
Borin was a trapper from the town of Mossbridges in the Vast, who ran a modest trapping business and traded with the Merchant House alongside his brothers in the late 14 century DR.
Bradlie Tagart was an inept Director of the Special Advisory Council Guard of Ravens Bluff in the mid–14 century DR.
Brandaeril was a War Wizard of Cormyr in the late 15 century DR.
Brabras was a bullyblade for Lord Traevyn Illance in the late 15 century DR.
Lord Braelbane was a nobleman of Cormyr, and a head of House Braelbane in the late 15 century DR.
Brassons was a rogue neogi restaurateur and owner of the Ocean's Wake bar on Dragon Rock in the Tears of Selûne in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Brammels was a Cashguard Basher in the employ of the Counting House of Baldur's Gate in the late 15 century DR.

Brachinas, also known as pleasure devils, were insidious baatezu, an enhanced form of erinyes who specialized in the art of seduction and corruption, particularly the servants of the gods. In the infernal rankings of devils, brachinas were generally concluded to be of the same rank as cornugons.
Breagar Coppervein was a dwarf merchant in Cormyr during the late 15 century DR.

Brass golems, also referred to as brass minotaurs, were a type of golem constructed from brass that were typically forged to resemble a minotaur. All were constructed to fulfill a singular goal, set at the time of their creation. This was typically to act as a guardian, but sometimes to carry out vengeance. If that goal became somehow unattainable they would lose their enchantment entirely and be rendered as nothing more than a statue.
Bowser was a passionate dwarvish "alesmith" from the city of Ravens Bluff in mid-to-late 14 century DR, who sought to create perfect ale.
Bran Cymrych was High King of the Moonshae Isles in the mid-to-late 4 century DR.
Branwyn Moonsinger was a Great Druid of the Moonshae Isles during the 15 century DR.
Brelma was a drow slaver, part of the infiltration of Scornubel in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Branson Blackboot was the innkeeper of the Old Man's Face inn in the village of Tyrluk in the kingdom of Cormyr in the late 15 century DR.
Bregubrod Dryctcyni was an adventuring conjurer who found love in an ogre's embrace, marrying Willac Tatthryd, a female ogre and a fellow adventurer in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Borgo the Scrounger was a quartermaster officer in Droic Orgul forces when he attacked Myth Drannor during the late 14 century DR.

Borgol was a male cyclops in service to the fomorians of the Underdark beneath the island of Gwynneth in the Moonshae Isles during the late 1470s DR. He was killed by drow in service to Prince Araithe of Sarifal.
Braznioch was a lord of salamanders during the mid-1480s DR.
Borlan was a human commoner inhabitant of Neverwinter's Beggar's Nest in the late 14 century DR.
Breatis was a half-orc barbarian and adventurer in Cormyr during the mid-1480s DR.
Brandon Olafsson was king of the Northlander kingdom of Gnarhelm in the Moonshae Isles during the mid-to-late-14 century DR.
Borial was an assassin with the School of Stealth in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Borstrand Mettlewinter was a banker of sorts in the village of Eveningstar during the 1480s DR.
Bors was a human cultist of the Dead Three active in Baldur's Gate as of the turn of the 16 century DR.

Brandywine Furfoot was a beautiful and charismatic hin cleric of Lliira and one of the winemakers and wine merchants of As the Vine Twines, located in Ravens Bluff, the Vast, in the mid-to-late 14 century DR.
Bosson Ketanya was a human thief and a spy for the Iron Throne in the late 14 century DR.
Breithel Olithir was the grand mage of the Tower of the Sun on the island of Evermeet and a member of the Council of Evermeet.
Lord Breden Yesve was a fey'ri with black fangs under the command of Sarya Dlardrageth. Sarya gave him command of the houses of Yesve and Ealoeth in order to keep Silverymoon at bay.
Braundlae was a waitress at Braundlae's Best beneath the Roving Dragon in Suzail, Cormyr.
Borun Fendelben was a lightfoot halfling and a member of the Council of Elders in Everlund as of 1372 DR.

The bulette ( ), also known as a landshark, was a fearsome magical beast. Feared and hated by most living creatures, bulettes were extremely dangerous, burrowing unseen beneath the soil before erupting up at an unexpected moment to seize their prey. Dwarves called the bulette a ghohlbrorn.
Briza Do'Urden was the eldest and most powerful of the daughters of Matron Mother Malice Do'Urden of House Do'Urden of Menzoberranzan.
Bronze dragons were a race of metallic dragons. Curious and inquisitive, they possessed a strong sense of justice and did not tolerate any form of cruelty.
Buldath Andryn was a taciturn and secretive mage who lived in Scornubel. He bought the remains of monsters and prepared them into magical reagents, to sell across the Sword Coast.
Briiathor Alougarr was the Lord Warder of Amphail and an unofficial member of Waterdeep's City Guard, though he was officially retired from that post.
Brunos Costak was one of the Western Divisional Leaders of the Iron Throne during the mid-14 century DR.
King Brindor Olósynne (born 998 DR, died 1128 DR) was a half-elf and the king of Aglarond between 1065 DR and 1128 DR as the beginning of the Olósynne Dynasty.
Brightwing was a female griffon, linked to the war-mage Aoth Fezim.
Brister Fendlestick was a human wizard of the early 14 century DR.
Brymoel was a male orc cleric and one of the son's of King Obould Many-Arrows.

King Bryndar was the third Obarskyr monarch of Cormyr. He was born in the Year of the Vow Manifest, 44 DR, and was the only son of Imlon Obarskyr, the second king of Cormyr. Bryndar reigned as king himself from the Year of Lamplit Nights, 57 DR, aged only 13, and ended his reign in the Year of Gleaming Frost, 64 DR, at age 20. Bryndar died young without producing an heir. He was succeeded by his uncle, Eskruis.
Briarsting was a thorn who was tasked with guarding the tomb of a long-dead druid in Waterdeep's City of the Dead.
Briarbones was an avolakia wizard who lived in the sewers of Waterdeep beneath Seawind Alley in the late 15 century DR. He was over 300 years old.
Busco Brawnanvil was the brother of Wocco Brawnanvil and first cousin to Banak Brawnanvil.
Bruenor Battlehammer I was a dwarf of Clan Battlehammer and the 2 King of Mithral Hall, and the namesake of the more widely known 8 and 10 king of Mithral Hall, Bruenor Battlehammer.
Bryseis Kakistos, a.k.a. Bysera, was a tiefling warlock who lived near Vaasa in the 14 century DR.
Bryon Kendrick was the king of Corwell in the early-to-mid–14 century DR. He was the father of Tristan Kendrick.
Buldegas Mhaerkoon was a human man living in the cities of Wheloon and Arabel in Cormyr. He was the proprietor of the Wyvern Watch Inn and another inn.
Bresnos Huantilar was a human male from Sembia and a member of the Saerloon chapter of the Cult of the Dragon.
Brigit Cu'Lyrran was the captain of the Sisters of Synnoria, warriors of the Llewyrr.

Buirin Thalshond was a merchant from the city of Tantras in the Vast in the mid–14 century DR. Speaking of treasure tales in the Vast in the Year of the Prince, 1357 DR, Buirin remarked "Treasure? Aye, lots of it in the Vast, lad; why didn't ye ask earlier? Oh… I see; ye wanted to live a while, first."
Briost Elthauryn was a magelord of Athalantar in the 3 century.
Brianne Byndraeth was one of the Masked Lord of Waterdeep who served during the mid–to–late 14 century DR.
Bryn Lightfingers was a strongheart halfling ranger from a clan in Red Larch in the late 15 century DR.
Bryth Moonaxe was a half-dwarf commander of the Knights of the Crescent Moon who arrived in Iltkazar in the year 1370 DR.
Brinna Alcott was a merchant living in Bryn Shander in 1485 DR.
Brusha was a bandit who lived in the Hordelands near Khazari during the mid–14th century DR.
Bryntarth II was a king of Cormyr. He was the son of Rhiigard "the Mourning King" and the father of Arangor Obarskyr.
Bruherd was an outcast drow member of House Duskryn in Menzoberranzan in the late 14 century DR.
Brightleaf was a treant in Cormanthor in the late 15 century DR.
Briglynn was a mystic of the Earthmother and a shopkeeper in Skullport.

Bruithyn Ammacaster was one of the top independent incense traders in Anauroch in 1358 DR. Bruithyn was famous for carrying an iron bands of Bilarro sphere, to deal with those who threatened him. When he traveled in Anauroch, he always had with him a bodyguard of Sembian mercenaries and a priest of Lathander from Eveningstar for healing. Bruithyn was popular at the temple of Lathandar for the gifts he gave to that faith.
Brianna Burdun () was a priestess of the giant goddess Hiatea and the queen of Hartsvale in 1366 DR.
Bridget Cymrych was a Ffolk human princess of Callidyrr on the island of Alaron in the Moonshae Isles in the 7th century DR.
Bruldin Oldturret was a member of the Soft Claws in Neverwinter in 1374 DR. He was a trader with a good knowledge of northern forest trails and backlands.
Bronwyn Daggerford was Duke Pwyll Greatshout's sister and a court wizard in Daggerford.
Broker was an officer in the Golden Legion and first captain of the Legion's cavalry.
Brindell was a halfling priestess of Eilistraee. Brindell was one of the Protectors of the Song in the Promenade of the Dark Maiden.
Broryn Windstag was a noble in Cormyr and a heir of the Windstag noble house during the late 15 century DR.
Brimskarda was a fire giant and the nagging wife of Duke Zalto in Ironslag sometime after the War of the Silver Marches.
Bucklal Boldover was a half-mad halfling thief in Myth Drannor in the Year of the Tankard, 1370 DR.
The Bride was an ancient titaness who was the consort of the primordial Cirotralech, and that was sealed alongside him in Fimbrul, Laerakond.

Brigitte Bannal was a mage and ruler of the Realm of Lands in the Utter East during the time of the Bloodforge Wars (648–657 DR). Brigitte understood how to use the complex terrain to her strategic advantage, making nature effectively a fortress. At last, the leader of the Legendary Campaign came to the Realm of Lands to overcome these defenses and defeat her in bloodforge battle, as part of a plan to unify the war-torn Utter East through conquest.
A brontosaurus (), also known as Thunderbeast, was a massive quadruped dinosaur.
Brog was an orc warrior from Many-Arrows who lived in Neverwinter in the late years of the 15 century DR.

Brunhilde Erikksson was the prop-and-costume-master for the Ravens Bluff Playhouse, as well as an officer within the city's bards' guild during the late 14 century DR. She acted as mother figure to the younger bards and performers within the guild, helping through their various artistic, romantic or existential crises as they arose. The experienced performer was considered a master actor, dancer and singer among her peers. She was proficient in speaking both dwarvish as well elven.
Brester Orthwood was the most competent son of House Orthwood, a fairly new noble house in Cormyr circa 1372 DR.
